# AI 引用页面的结构与专业性研究

- 作者：Alex Groberman（@alexgroberman）
- 发布时间：2026-10-25 21:58（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/alexgroberman/status/2114356029177651402
- 说明：中文全文翻译，后附英文原文。文中数据、观点及推广内容均为作者表述，未经独立验证。

---

## 中文全文

具有某一种特征的网站，被 AI 平台引用的频率高出 1.8 倍。

现在，数据终于具体到足以指导行动。

一项研究分析了 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode 和 Perplexity 中的 11,882 个提示词及 304,805 个被引用网址，然后将它们与 Google 排名前 20、但未被 AI 引用的 921,614 个网址进行了比较。

最大的差异是什么？

表达清晰度和总结质量（+32.83%）；作者资历、专家来源等信号（+30.64%）；问答格式（+25.45%）；使用标题、列表和表格的清晰章节结构（+22.91%）；以及结构化数据（+21.60%）。

换句话说，AI 系统倾向于引用的页面，通常表达更清晰、结构更好，并且有更强的专业知识支撑。

根据 Semrush 的说法，提供清晰作者信息的来源，被引用的频率是匿名内容的 1.8 倍。

这意味着，写明作者姓名、展示相关资历并引用可信的专家来源，显著改善了 AI 系统在决定引用什么时能够获得的信号。

Semrush 的数据显示，被引用页面更有可能清楚地传达答案、使用结构化章节、预先考虑问题，并展示真实的专业知识。

请注意，一个页面可能与搜索足够相关、能够获得排名，却仍然不是理想的引用候选。而表现最强的内容往往结合了两件事。

第一，以专业知识为基础的有用内容：实名作者、原创数据、专家观点、直接答案，以及对买家问题的全面覆盖。

事实上，Semrush 发现，问答格式与约高出 25% 的引用率相关，而清晰的章节结构与约高出 23% 的引用率相关。

第二，能够强化专业性的权威信号。

可信的第三方报道、编辑推荐的反向链接，以及可信网站的引用，都会给搜索和 AI 系统提供更多证据，表明内容及其背后的公司值得信任。

## 英文原文

Websites with one specific characteristic get cited by AI platforms 1.8x more often.

Now the data is finally specific enough to act on.

A study analyzed 11,882 prompts and 304,805 cited URLs across ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Perplexity, then compared them against 921,614 URLs ranking in Google's top 20 that were not cited by AI.

The biggest differences?

Clarity and summarization quality (+32.83%), signals like author credentials and expert sources (+30.64%), Q&A formatting (+25.45%), clear section structure with headings, lists and tables (+22.91%) and structured data (+21.60%).

In other words, the pages AI systems tend to cite are generally clearer, better structured and backed by stronger expertise.

seo-stuff.com/free-audit

According to Semrush, sources with clear author information were cited 1.8x more often than anonymous content.

That means naming the author, showing relevant credentials and citing credible expert sources materially improved the signals AI systems have available when deciding what to cite.

Semrush's data shows that cited pages were much more likely to communicate the answer clearly, use structured sections, anticipate questions and demonstrate actual expertise.

Mind you, a page can be relevant enough to rank and still be a poor citation candidate. And the strongest-performing content tends to combine two things.

First, useful content built around expertise: named authors, original data, expert perspectives, direct answers and comprehensive coverage of the buyer's question.

In fact, Semrush found Q&A formatting correlated with roughly 25% higher citation rates, while strong section structure correlated with roughly 23% higher rates.

Second, authority that reinforces the expertise.

Credible third-party coverage, editorial backlinks and references from trusted websites give search and AI systems more evidence that the content and the company behind it are worth trusting.
